results.title: The app is served over HTTPS end to end (login + data call)
Plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS (no app content over HTTP)
HSTS (1 year) on every HTTPS response; Server/Via banners removed
Legacy TLS 1.0/1.1 handshakes are refused; TLS 1.2+ accepted
Refresh cookie carries Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict in production
A forged X-Forwarded-For through the edge is ignored: the API records the real client IP

results.title: TRACE is not echoed back (no cross-site tracing)
A verified database dump and receipts archive exist; the backup service is healthy
Restore drill: the latest dump restores into an empty database with identical row counts
Every long-running service restarts automatically (unless-stopped)
Container logs rotate (json-file, 10 MB × 5) so they cannot fill the disk
Memory limits on every service (fit a 2–4 GB VM); Postgres tuned
Every long-running service has a healthcheck and is healthy
Least privilege: no-new-privileges on all; read-only rootfs and no capabilities for app containers
Only the TLS edge publishes ports; database, API and web are internal
All base images are pinned to exact versions
The app shell revalidates on every load; hashed assets are cached for a year
No fonts are inlined as data: URIs (they would be blocked by the CSP)
The worker stops gracefully on SIGTERM well within the grace period and comes back healthy
CI runs install, type-check, unit tests and builds on every push
